general.description: General-purpose subagent for easy multi-step tasks including web research (OpenRouter auto routes to best available free model)

explore.description: Fast read-only subagent for codebase exploration and web searches (OpenRouter auto routes to best available free model)

k8s-validator.description: Validates Kubernetes manifests, Kustomize overlays, and Helm charts for syntax errors and best practices

gitops-reviewer.description: Reviews ArgoCD Application/ApplicationSet manifests and GitOps bootstrap patterns for correctness

helm-reviewer.description: Reviews Helm chart values, kustomization with helmCharts, and chart configurations for correctness

input-optimizer.description: Condenses verbose user prompts into minimal input tokens while preserving all requirements and intent — use before sending complex tasks to other agents
